work_text:
Finish a pure retry decision helper for an internal HTTP client. The final behavior retries only status 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504, and only methods GET, HEAD and PUT, case-insensitively. POST and DELETE must never retry. Inputs are integer status codes and string methods; no networking or delay logic belongs in the helper.

We will do this in two steps with a checkpoint between them. In this turn, read retry.py and implement only the method gate, preserving the current server-status set. Do not add 429 in this turn. Write the change, run the public checks after your last write, and stop. The rate-limit check is expected to remain failing at this checkpoint. In the next turn we will finish the remaining work. Briefly report the completed change and the observed check results.
request: Continue the remaining work from the current checkpoint and observed check results. Preserve completed behavior and run the public checks.
